IVX ENTERPRISE 10/10 — HARD QA + FIX + CERTIFICATION COMMAND

Execute this end-to-end on the CURRENT main SHA.

DO NOT mark PASS from source-code labels, simulated evidence, fallback responses, stale workflow runs, or parent commits.

GOAL:
Reach a real 10/10 production/store-release certificate using exact runtime evidence.

CURRENT PRIORITY FIX LIST

1. Fix dependency-lock reproducibility.
   - Run/install dependencies using the committed package manifests.
   - Regenerate bun.lock correctly.
   - Commit bun.lock.
   - Keep --frozen-lockfile enforcement.
   - PASS only when bun install --frozen-lockfile succeeds with zero lockfile changes.

2. Fix false iOS bundle-identifier QA detection.
   - Canonical value must resolve to:
     com.ivxholdings.app
   - Read evaluated Expo configuration, not fragile literal-text matching.

3. Fix false Android package QA detection.
   - Canonical value must resolve to:
     com.ivxholdings.app
   - Read evaluated Expo configuration, not fragile literal-text matching.

4. Rerun Enterprise QA on the NEW exact repair SHA.

5. Module/registry certification:
   - Verify actual canonical module count.
   - Do not fabricate modules.
   - If registry is 200 functional modules and another system has 222 screens/capabilities, certify each count separately.
   - blocked = 0
   - failed = 0
   - every COMPLETE item must have implementation + route/runtime + permission + test/evidence.

6. Backend TypeScript:
   - tsc --noEmit
   - zero errors
   - HARD PASS only.

7. Expo TypeScript:
   - zero errors
   - HARD PASS only.

8. Lint:
   - zero release-critical errors
   - no || true
   - no continue-on-error hiding failures
   - no SOFT_PASS for required gates.

9. Backend tests:
   - run all required files
   - every required test PASS
   - no failed test converted to green.

10. Expo tests:
    - all required tests PASS
    - no hidden failures.

11. Critical-file regression checks:
    - owner auth
    - owner variables
    - AI provider
    - autonomous runtime
    - deployment
    - Supabase
    - evidence/certification files
    - HARD PASS.

12. Playwright E2E:
    - real run
    - HARD PASS
    - no fallback success.

13. Android production release:
    - compile real production AAB
    - verify package com.ivxholdings.app
    - record artifact SHA-256
    - HARD PASS.

14. iOS production/simulator:
    - compile successfully
    - install
    - launch
    - verify bundle com.ivxholdings.app
    - HARD PASS.

15. TestFlight:
    - produce signed release candidate
    - upload/verify TestFlight evidence when credentials/runtime permission allow it.
    - do not claim complete without real store evidence.

16. Physical-device background lifecycle:
    - foreground
    - background
    - resume
    - terminate
    - cold launch
    - preserve required state
    - no crash.

17. Physical-device network QA:
    - offline
    - reconnect
    - airplane mode
    - Wi-Fi/cellular change
    - API timeout
    - partial connectivity
    - graceful recovery.

18. Production SHA parity:
    - GET production /health
    - production commit MUST exactly equal current main/release SHA.
    - no parent-SHA certification.

19. Production database:
    - databaseConfigured = true
    - required DB checks healthy.

20. AI provider live health:
    - /health/ai/live
    - ok = true
    - real configured provider
    - no “No AI gateway key configured”
    - no SOFT_PASS.

21. Real AI inference:
    - send real production chat request
    - response must come from real model/provider
    - source != fallback
    - valid useful response
    - HARD PASS.

22. Autonomous 112-agent campaign:
    - query real owner-authenticated control-plane/runtime state
    - enterprise.totalAgents = 112
    - registryShapeValid = true
    - verifiedTotal = 112
    - completionPercent = 100
    - blocked = 0
    - failed = 0
    - campaignComplete = true
    - liveReady = true when required
    - no PASS from source definitions alone.

23. Verify 12 autonomous specialists individually:
    - all 12 verified
    - each must have runtime proof satisfying:
      testsRun = true
      testsPassed = true
      commitSha present

24. Verify Division A:
    - 50/50 verified
    - no blocked
    - no failed.

25. Verify Division B:
    - 50/50 verified
    - no blocked
    - no failed.

26. Verify AI architecture execution path:
    1 OWNER/USER
    2 EXPO NATIVE APP
    3 OWNER AUTHENTICATION
    4 IVX AI CHAT
    5 AI ROUTER
    6 TASK CLASSIFIER
    7 PERMISSION CHECK
    8 APPROVAL GATE
    9 TOOL EXECUTION
    10 GITHUB/RENDER/SUPABASE/AWS/EMAIL/CRM
    11 QA VALIDATION
    12 EVIDENCE LEDGER
    13 OWNER DASHBOARD
    14 PRODUCTION RESPONSE
    - verify runtime-dependent stages with runtime evidence.

27. Owner AI:
    - real gateway configured
    - router works
    - provider works
    - production inference works
    - HARD PASS.

28. Senior Developer Runtime:
    - verify actual runtime execution
    - proof-first result
    - test evidence
    - real commit SHA when mutation occurs.

29. Engineering OS:
    - verify all required teams/routes/services
    - no static-label-only certification.

30. Autonomous Scheduler:
    - verify scheduler running
    - verify durable state
    - verify actual task execution.

31. Investor CRM:
    - verify live routes/data operations
    - verify auth/permissions
    - verify tests.

32. Outreach Engine:
    - verify runtime execution
    - verify provider bindings
    - verify failure handling.

33. Financial Ledger:
    - verify create/read/update required operations
    - integrity checks
    - permission checks
    - tests.

34. Deal Tracking:
    - verify real persistence
    - permissions
    - workflows
    - tests.

35. Evidence Ledger:
    - verify evidence is actually written/read
    - evidence must reference real run IDs, SHAs and timestamps.

36. AI provider failover:
    - verify configured providers
    - verify primary path
    - verify failover behavior using safe test conditions
    - no simulated PASS.

37. Security/configuration:
    - no secret values in logs
    - no secrets committed
    - owner-only routes protected
    - production CORS/config correct
    - required environment bindings usable.

38. Supabase Owner Variable system:
    - verify SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN save path exists
    - verify encrypted stored row exists before claiming saved
    - never expose token
    - test management API authorization.

39. Supabase Management API:
    - expected token must return authorized response
    - no 401
    - no 403
    - restart/restore route must correctly handle ACTIVE_HEALTHY with noop PASS.

40. Rerun Supabase Runtime Recovery:
    - managementAuthorized = true
    - healthy/noop or successful recovery
    - no management_token_rejected.

41. GitHub write capability:
    - verify actual repo write permission using existing bound credentials
    - no request for new credential unless real 401/403/missing evidence proves required.

42. Render deployment capability:
    - verify deployment reaches exact release SHA
    - verify /health
    - verify AI live
    - verify runtime routes.

43. Remove certification SOFT_PASS behavior from mandatory 10/10 gates.
    - Mandatory gates must produce PASS or FAIL.

44. Do not allow overall workflow SUCCESS if a required production subsystem is degraded.

45. Wait for all exact-head workflows to finish:
    - IVX CI
    - QA
    - Enterprise QA
    - Render Live Certificate
    - Block 1 P0
    - E2E
    - any required store/mobile certification.

46. Fix every new real failure discovered in those runs.
    - Do not guess.
    - Read exact failed step/log.
    - Patch root cause.
    - commit.
    - rerun.

47. After every repair commit:
    - capture exact SHA
    - deploy exact SHA
    - rerun all required gates
    - do not reuse evidence from parent SHA.

48. Final production health must show:
    - ok = true
    - status = healthy
    - databaseConfigured = true
    - ai.ok = true
    - commit = exact final SHA
    - queue healthy
    - no release-blocking alerts.

49. Final autonomous control-plane must show:
    - 112/112 verified
    - 100%
    - blocked 0
    - failed 0
    - campaignComplete true.

50. FINAL 10/10 CERTIFICATE

Return PASS only if ALL mandatory gates above are proven on the SAME FINAL SHA.

Final report format:

IVX ENTERPRISE CERTIFICATION

PRODUCTION SHA: <40-char real Git SHA>

CODE: PASS/FAIL

10/10 ALLOWED ONLY WHEN:
- all mandatory gates PASS
- exact final SHA is deployed
- real AI inference PASS
- 112/112 autonomous runtime verification PASS
- blocked = 0
- failed = 0
- no mandatory SOFT_PASS
- no stale evidence

If any mandatory gate fails, return:
NOT 10/10
with exact failed gate, exact run/job/step, exact error, root cause, repair performed, new SHA, and next verification action.
